name: usage-sync
description: Records this device's Claude Code token usage and syncs it to a GitHub repository, so usage from every machine adds up in one place.

repo.title: Data repository
repo.description: The GitHub repository the usage files go to, as owner/name (e.g. 9akashnp8/claude-usage-data). It must already have a commit on the branch below.

token.title: GitHub token
token.description: A fine-grained personal access token with Contents: read and write on the data repository only.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: The branch the usage files are committed to.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The folder in the repository that holds one <device>.json per machine.

device.title: Device name
device.description: This machine's file name in the repository. Leave empty to use its host name.

device_label.title: Device label
device_label.description: How this machine is named on the dashboard, e.g. Work laptop. Leave empty to use the device name.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: The IANA time zone days and hours are counted in, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Use the same one on every machine. Leave empty for this machine's.

sync_interval_minutes.title: Sync interval (minutes)
sync_interval_minutes.description: How often an open session uploads this machine's usage. Sessions on one machine share the interval.
